# m.indicators.ema

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The exponential moving average of a ticker's bars, one row per bar.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.indicators.ema(symbols, window=50, *, timespan=dm.Timespan.DAY, series_type=dm.SeriesType.CLOSE, adjusted=True, start=None, end=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol` and `TimestampStart`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers of any asset class. `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| `window` | The number of bars the average spans. |
| [`timespan`](README.md#timespan) | The bar size, `MINUTE` or longer. |
| `series_type` | The bar price the indicator is computed from. |
| [`adjusted`](README.md#adjusted) | Split-adjusted bars. It has no effect on a crypto pair, which has no splits. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first bar's start. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The end of the range, of the same kind as `start`. |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of the bars' times. The endpoints have no `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows for each symbol. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters. Keys: none. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `/v1/indicators/ema/{stockTicker}`: the request's `stockTicker` parameter; REST `/v1/indicators/ema/{cryptoTicker}`: the request's `cryptoTicker` parameter. |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the bar, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the date of `TimestampStart` in the day zone of the symbol's class (UTC for forex and crypto, New York otherwise) for an intraday or 1-day bar, and null for a bar that spans more than one date (several days, a week or longer, or an intraday bar that crosses midnight). Joining an intraday row to the same day's daily bar on `Date` attaches values not known until that day ended, and a null `Date` matches another null, so join longer bars on `TimestampEnd`. |
| `TimestampStart` | Instant | The start of the bar the value is computed at, as an Instant. A bar of a day or longer starts at 00:00 of its window's first day in the day zone of the symbol's class (UTC for forex and crypto, New York otherwise). A bar of a day or longer stamped at a time or on a day Massive is not known to use is withheld, with a WARNING, since which day it covers is not known. From REST `timestamp`: "The Unix Msec timestamp from the last aggregate used in this calculation." |
| `TimestampEnd` | Instant | The exclusive end of the bar's window, as an Instant: the first instant at which the bar is complete, so an as-of join on it, `t.aj(bars, on=["Symbol", "Timestamp>=TimestampEnd"])`, never attaches a bar that is still open. It is when the window closes, not when Massive published the bar, and Massive may correct a bar later. An intraday bar ends at Massive's `e` where the WebSocket sends one, else its length after its start; a WARNING says when the two differ. A bar of a day or longer ends at 00:00, in the day zone of the symbol's class, after its window's last day. A row read before its window ended has `TimestampInsert` before `TimestampEnd`, and its values can still change; `t.where("TimestampEnd <= TimestampInsert")` keeps only the rows read after their window ended. That test reads the local clock, which can be off, and a row read within moments of its end, or from a delayed feed, may still lack the window's last trades; an end set later than the window's (an index day's extra hour) only keeps a finished row out longer. |
| `Value` | double | The MACD line value, calculated as the difference between the short-term and long-term exponential moving averages (EMAs) based on the periods specified in the request parameters. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
